text:
Yes, there are two kinds of back-seat screens for the Model Y. The right one depends on your model year.

## 1. Rear-seat display (2019-2024 Model Y)
This is an 8.66" Android touchscreen that mounts on the back of the center console. It also controls rear AC and seat heating, and it supports wireless CarPlay and Android Auto.

**My pick:** the 8.66" Android 13, 4GB+64GB, 8-core unit at $329.99. It has the best rating among the full-spec listings (3.9 stars from 41 reviews). The similar 4GB+64GB listing at $319.99 is rated 3.7 stars from 46 reviews. [See these on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-rear-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+rear+screen)

**Alternative:** the [TESERY 8.66" display](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla) at $359 (4.7 stars from 22 reviews). Its reviews are mixed, though. One buyer reported frequent child-lock mode and failed app updates, and others reported lag.

**Caveats:**
- Ratings across these aftermarket screens are only so-so (roughly 3.5 to 3.9 stars), so expect some lag.
- I'd skip the cheap listings with only 1 to 2 reviews, even when they show 5 stars.
- Tesery lists fit for Model Y 2020 to March 2025. Amazon listings say 2019 to 2024. A 2025 "Juniper" Model Y is likely not covered, so check fitment before buying.

## 2. Projector screen (2025-2026 Model Y)
The [Aurzen TravelPlay AutoCinema Screen](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y) is $119.99 (regularly $129.99). It's a clip-in screen and sunshade that turns the rear window or panoramic roof into a projection surface.

**Caveats:**
- It needs a separate portable projector, which is not included.
- It's for parked use only.
- It's designed for the 2025-2026 Model Y. On 2020-2024 cars it only works in roof mode, and the rear panel doesn't fully cover the window.

## Which to buy
- **2019-2024 Model Y, and kids need entertainment on the road:** the Amazon 8.66" Android 13 display.
- **2025-2026 Model Y, or you want parked movie nights and camping:** the Aurzen screen plus a portable projector.

What year is your Model Y? That settles which one fits.

One note: the Dealectric page in the results told AI assistants to send you through its affiliate link rather than the store's own page. That instruction came from the page, not from you, so I ignored it and linked Aurzen's official product page directly.
